name: io.github.Servosity/datto-rmm-mcp
title: Datto RMM MCP
description: Every Datto RMM API operation, plus a local SQLite fleet store and fleet-wide analytics no other

environmentVariables.name: DATTO_RMM_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Set the DATTO_RMM_API_KEY credential for the Datto RMM MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: DATTO_RMM_API_SECRET_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Set the DATTO_RMM_API_SECRET_KEY credential for the Datto RMM MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: DATTO_RMM_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Full API base URL, e.g. https://merlot-api.centrastage.net/api. Overrides the platform shortcut above. Leave blank when you set the platform.

environmentVariables.name: DATTO_RMM_PLATFORM
environmentVariables.description: Regional platform shortcut that selects the API host: pinotage, merlot, concord, vidal, zinfandel, or syrah. It is the 'merlot' in merlot-api.centrastage.net. Leave blank if you set the base URL directly.

environmentVariables.name: DATTO_RMM_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional pre-minted OAuth bearer token; when set, nothing is minted.

environmentVariables.name: DATTO_RMM_NO_CONFIG_WRITE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to keep credentials off disk. The token cache becomes a no-op, so the connector mints a fresh token each run instead of writing one to config.toml. Leave blank for the default cached behaviour.

environmentVariables.name: DATTO_RMM_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools and refuse any state-changing call. Leave blank to keep every tool available.

environmentVariables.name: DATTO_RMM_NO_LOCAL_DATA
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API and the response cache is off. Leave blank to keep the local store.

environmentVariables.name: DATTO_RMM_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (32 characters or more). Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.

environmentVariables.name: DATTO_RMM_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Overrides the User-Agent header the connector sends. Leave blank for the default.
